## Scope

The audit covered 467 second reads taken during the quarter under review. It considered the level of agreement across the audited reads and provides an overall view of grading consistency for the period. The scope was limited to the second reads included in the audit. Detailed information for individual graders is provided separately in the attached spreadsheet.

## Result

Overall agreement was 61.9 per cent. This result represents the combined agreement recorded across the audited second reads. It should be considered alongside the detailed per-grader results, which provide additional context on the overall finding. The per-grader results are in the attached spreadsheet and are discussed with each grader privately. These discussions support a consistent and appropriate review of the results while maintaining the confidentiality of individual performance information.
